function.name: search
function.description: Search the local BC+ corpus for candidate documents. Returns stable D# document handles and short raw-text previews with W# window handles. A preview is not exhaustive document content.

query.description: A standalone global search query, usually in English

function.name: find
function.description: Locate a specific fact inside one previously discovered D# document using a local lexical query. Returns an exact raw-text W# window. Use a different find query for another fact in the same document.

doc_ref.description: Stable document handle returned by search, for example D3

query.description: Local query for the fact or passage to locate

function.name: open
function.description: Read adjacent raw text around an observed W# window. before/after read neighboring text; around expands the current span. Use find, not repeated open, to locate a different fact elsewhere.

window_ref.description: Stable observed-window handle returned by search, find, or open
